name: Chemistry
notes: Any six chemistry courses of four credits or more, totalling at least 24 credit hours.
300-level courses are NOT included. 400-level courses may be included with instructor permission - not modeled.
CHEM 111 Molecules of Power may NOT be used; it is intended for humanities and social science concentrators.
BIOL 250 is no longer an allowed substitute for CHEM 262 for newly created programs of study.
Prerequisites for advanced courses (mathematics, physics) must be taken IN ADDITION to the six chemistry courses.
Two courses with substantial overlap of content should not both be included.
Overlap rule: no major and minor may overlap by more than two courses. Exempt from that rule: BIOL 110L/111L/112L/113L, CHEM 131/137 and CHEM 132, CSC 161/171/172.

requirementGroups.label: Six chemistry courses (24+ credits)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Any six courses in chemistry that meet the following guidelines: Courses must be four credits or more; Courses at the 300 level are not included; CHEM 111: Molecules of Power may NOT be used. All of the courses should total at least 24 credit-hours in chemistry.
